jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: the Burlington Supervisory District is its own supervisory district, its district the Burlington School District (sole municipality: the City of Burlington).

sources.note: Burlington city charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 3 section 163: 'The Board of School Commissioners of said City shall be composed of 12 school commissioners. One commissioner from Ward One through Eight inclusive and one commissioner from each of the four districts shall be elected...' Section 4 provides each seat is elected only by the voters of its own ward or city district, and section 164 sets two-year terms (district seats in odd years, ward seats in even years). Charter section 165 fills vacancies by election only -- this board has no appointed members.

Burlington School District board members page (official): the twelve current school commissioners with their wards/districts and term-end years -- the eight ward seats end 2028, the four city-district seats end 2027.
